name: @carrasco-leo/angular-pug-compiler
description: Compile Pug templates to HTML for Angular templateUrl, with include-dependency tracking and watch mode.
author: Léo CARRASCO

scripts.clean: node --input-type=module -e "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('lib', { recursive: true, force: true })"
scripts.build:cjs: tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && node --input-type=module -e "import { writeFileSync } from 'node:fs'; writeFileSync('lib/commonjs/package.json', JSON.stringify({ type: 'commonjs' }, null, 2) + '\n')"
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.prepack: npm run typecheck && npm run build
